name: Securitize Tokenized AAA CLO Fund
oneLiner: STAC is a Securitize-issued tokenized AAA CLO private fund (BVI), custodied at BNY and sub-advised by BNY Investments; NAV-accreting Rule 506(c) share.
collateral: Tokenized fund shares in Securitize AAA CLO Tokenized Fund, Ltd., a BVI private fund investing substantially all assets in U.S. dollar-denominated AAA-rated CLO tranches, with BNY as custodian and BNY Investments as sub-advisor.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized private-fund share, not a fixed $1 peg; eligible investors subscribe via Securitize, shares issued on Ethereum and Solana under KYC/AML and qualification controls, with limited liquidity and no guaranteed secondary market.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: STAC is a digital share of an unlevered private fund that invests substantially all assets in U.S. dollar AAA CLO tranches. Its value and redemption follow fund NAV rather than a fixed-par issuer claim, so the live instrument is a tokenized structured-credit fund and maps to rwa-credit-fund.
